claimBoundary: Independent checked comparison of each requested production binary64 N1, N2, and N4 CPU recast against the matching separately executed Star-only omitted-ground request. This policy does not cover GPU construction, reflective ground, final-view rendering, or Stage 9.6.3.

inputAuthentication.rule: The production source falloff, complete source-irradiance packet, native-15 basis identity, canonical atmosphere constants, and native production profile identities must exactly equal these predeclared inputs.

factsAndDomains.rule: Every compared scalar and semantic value must be exactly equal after normalization into the documented Star order.

behavioralEdges.rule: Every shell min/max/internal-boundary neighbor record, source-radius clamp record, and zero-length/finite/ground-blocked/top-clipped source-path record must be exactly equal after production-unit normalization.

fields.rule: Compare every production request-local field against the same field from the matching separately executed Star request. Accept a scalar when its absolute error is at most its quantity-specific absolute tolerance plus its relative tolerance multiplied by the absolute Star authority value.

orderInvariants.rule: On both the independently executed Star results and the independently requested production results, N1, N2, and N4 shared pure-field prefixes must be exactly equal. Each cumulative field must exactly equal its request-local pure-field sum in ascending order.

acceptance.state: Pass only when fixture and source authentication, all predeclared numerical inputs, fixed facts and domains, every requested-order field comparison, and every order invariant pass.

residentCumulativeSampling.observation: Every exact-node public cache sample equals its resident cumulative field value.
residentCumulativeSampling.inference: Exact equality establishes zero additional query-time shell-held scaling.
